purpose: evidence only - diagnosis/partition; assigns no disposition and grants no authority
method: Mapping uses the mutation identity plus class/method/descriptor/mutator/description/block/index, the pc-ordered instruction sequence and the line-number table. PIT block/index are NOT bytecode offsets. Alignment rule: the candidate instruction set for a method+mutator is restricted to line-bearing instructions of that mutator's kind and aligned in pc order to every PIT mutant of that method+mutator (including KILLED ones), then corroborated by requiring PIT's reported line to equal the mapped pc's line-table line. A count mismatch leaves the row AMBIGUOUS.
